title: Rogan's offline explanation of Lazar's deleted MIT records

tellings.quote: whenever he comes up with Rogan, Rogan always says, "Oh, I'll tell you something offline where like it would make the MIT records being deleted make sense."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on alien craft for the US government, has long faced questions because records of his time at MIT, a university in Massachusetts, cannot be found. Michels says that the podcaster Joe Rogan, whenever Lazar comes up, says he could explain "offline" something that would make the deleted MIT records make sense. Michels passes this on second-hand, and Rogan's explanation itself is never given.
